skill.summary: High-performance, multi-source Korean search API aggregating Daum/Kakao News, Encyclopedia, and Web results in a Perplexity-compatible format.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of daum-toy-search: a high-performance, multi-source Korean search API.
- Aggregates Daum/Kakao News, Encyclopedia, and Web results.
- Fully compatible with the Perplexity Search API format.
- Includes intelligent 3x Jaccard keyword overlap reranking.
- Fast response times with Go concurrency (sub-400ms average latency).
- Outputs clean, structured JSON or formatted Markdown for AI agent ingestion.
